domains.title: Custom domains
domains.description: Hostnames bound to {slug}. Add a domain, copy the validation TXT record into your DNS provider, then click Recheck once it propagates.
domains.emptyDescription: Add a hostname like checkout.acme.com to point at this app's primary public workload. Removing a domain later detaches it from ingress — the platform stops routing traffic for that hostname and the cert is freed.

addSheet.title: Add custom domain
addSheet.description: The platform issues a cert via Let's Encrypt once the DNS validation record is in place.
addSheet.byoFollowup: Hostname is still validated via DNS-TXT. After it goes live, upload your certificate via the per-domain Replace action below.

methodHints.dns_txt: Default. Operator adds a TXT record at _astrolift-challenge.<hostname>.
methodHints.http_01: ACME HTTP-01 challenge served from the cluster's ingress controller. Pick this when DNS edits are slow.
methodHints.dns_01: ACME DNS-01 challenge. Required for wildcards and zones where ACM / cloud cert manager handles the records.
methodHints.byo_cert: Skip ACME entirely. Validate via DNS-TXT, then paste your own PEM chain + private key.

remove.title: Remove {hostname}?
remove.description: Soft-deletes the app↔hostname binding. The cert is freed and the hostname becomes available to re-add to another app. The DNS record at your provider is unaffected.

cert.edgeAuthUngatedHelp: This app's platform subdomain is behind the cluster's login gate; this custom domain is not, so anyone with the URL reaches the app. The gate's session cookie is scoped to the platform's own zone and cannot cover an external domain.
cert.platformManagedHelp: Platform-managed records — astrolift owns the zone and creates these via the DNS driver. No operator action needed; the recheck below is a probe.
cert.liveHelp: These records are live in your DNS. Cert active.
cert.needsHelp: Add these records to your authoritative DNS, then click Recheck. The platform queries your zone's nameservers directly so propagation typically takes < 5 min.
cert.allPropagated: All records propagated. Validation should flip to validated on the next workflow tick (or click Recheck to force one).
cert.noHandshake: Handshake not generated yet — re-add the domain to refresh its required records.
cert.issuingPlatform: DNS-01 challenge in progress with the cloud cert manager.
cert.issuingExternal: HTTP-01 challenge running against your CNAME target.
cert.activeDesc: Serving HTTPS for {hostname}. The renderer picks the cert up automatically on the next deploy.
cert.byoNote: The platform won't auto-rotate this cert. Re-upload before its expiry to avoid a service interruption.
cert.failedHelp: Common causes: external DNS zone on AWS (ACM can't HTTP-01), Let's Encrypt rate limit on the apex, or the CNAME isn't reachable on port 80. Upload your own certificate to bypass auto-issuance, or fix the upstream cause and click Recheck.
cert.queued: DNS validated. Certificate issuance queued — should start within a minute. If it doesn't, click Recheck to retrigger.

upload.title: Upload certificate for {hostname}
upload.description: Paste the full PEM-encoded certificate chain (leaf + any intermediates) and the matching private key. The platform stores the bundle and projects it as a Kubernetes TLS Secret on the runtime cluster on the next deploy. Replaces any in-flight auto-issuance.
upload.certInvalid: Doesn't look like a PEM CERTIFICATE block.
upload.keyInvalid: Doesn't look like a PEM-encoded private key.
upload.noRotate: The platform won't auto-rotate this cert. Track its expiry yourself; re-upload before it lapses to avoid a service interruption.

ingress.label: ingress
ingress.description: When paused, the app's ingresses return HTTP 503 to all callers. Use this for planned maintenance windows — the workload keeps running so you can still ship deploys and observe metrics. Resume restores routing.
ingress.maintenanceDesc: Every bound hostname is returning 503. Health probes that hit ingress will fail; in-cluster probes are unaffected.

policy.title: Deploy-gating policy
policy.description: What the promote-deploy workflow refuses to roll out. Rules evaluate at the moment of promotion against the latest scan + the signature on the image digest.

features.title: Features
features.description: Toggle runtime feature flags for this install, and review the install-time features that require a redeploy to change.
features.runtimeDescription: Flip these live — the change takes effect immediately across the install. Backed by Constance; platform-admin only.
features.runtimeEmpty: No runtime feature flags are published on this install.
features.installDescription: These gate app loading at boot and cannot be flipped at runtime — change the environment variable and redeploy. Shown for visibility.
features.installEmpty: No install-time features are reported by this install.
features.requiresRedeploy: Requires a redeploy — set {env} and restart.
features.disableDescription: This takes effect immediately for everyone on this install. Turning the flag off can hide whole surfaces and remove entries from the sidebar. You can turn it back on here.
features.enableDescription: This takes effect immediately for everyone on this install. Turning the flag on can expose new surfaces and add entries to the sidebar. You can turn it back off here.
features.updateError: Could not update the feature flag.

metrics.title: Platform metrics
metrics.description: Fleet health, in-cluster Prometheus saturation, and cloud-provider system metrics across your organization's clusters.
metrics.emptyDescription: Register a tenant cluster to start collecting platform metrics. Cluster saturation and system metrics populate once a cluster is managed and reachable.
metrics.noAgentDescription: No keep-alive agent has reported from this cluster yet. Install the agent from cluster settings to see live state.
metrics.offlineAge: Cluster offline — last seen {seconds, plural, one {# second ago} other {# seconds ago}}.
metrics.saturationDescription: In-cluster Prometheus golden signals — current snapshot and trend over the selected window.
metrics.systemDescription: Cloud-provider metrics — no in-app instrumentation required.
metrics.promNoEndpointBody: The control plane hasn't discovered a Prometheus endpoint for this cluster yet.
metrics.promNoEndpointHint: Run Refresh cluster management from Settings to auto-discover the endpoint, or set prometheus_endpoint in provider_config.
metrics.promUnreachableBody: The control plane can't reach the Prometheus endpoint stored for this cluster.
metrics.promUnreachableHint: Verify the endpoint is reachable from the control plane on port 9090.
metrics.cloudUnsupportedTitle: Cloud metrics not available for this provider
metrics.cloudUnsupportedBody: The {provider} driver has no cloud-metrics integration wired yet. System metrics are sourced from CloudWatch on AWS clusters today.
metrics.cloudUnreachableBody: The cloud provider's metrics API couldn't be reached (missing credentials or throttled). In-cluster Prometheus metrics above are unaffected.

playground.title: Model playground
playground.singlePrompt: Each submission sends one user prompt to the selected endpoint. Previous displayed turns are not sent.
playground.localOnly: Saved only in this browser for this organization and user. Up to 30 sessions; no server history.
playground.noEndpoints: No visible endpoints match this search.
playground.relayAdvisory: Up to {chars} prompt characters and {tokens} output tokens; waits up to {seconds} seconds. Heartbeats do not advertise relay capability. The actual request can still fail or time out; access and configuration are checked again when sent.
playground.emptyChat: Select an endpoint and submit a concrete prompt to see its actual reply.
playground.batchLimits: At most six nonempty prompt lines, each up to 4,000 characters. Runs sequentially; six prompts per minute per user and one job per cluster. No automatic retries. Cancel stops future prompts; a submitted server job can still finish.
playground.batchInvalid: Use one to six prompt lines, each within the character limit.
playground.emptyResults: Actual replies and failures appear here after submission.
playground.saveFailed: Could not save the session in this browser.
playground.loadFailed: Could not load this local session.

readiness.READY: Ready to attempt a prompt; relay support is unverified.
readiness.UNSUPPORTED: Prompt invocation is supported only for app-owned vLLM endpoints. This provider is unavailable in the playground.
readiness.UNKNOWN_HEARTBEAT: The cluster has no recorded agent heartbeat.
readiness.STALE_HEARTBEAT: The agent heartbeat is stale; the relay is disconnected.
readiness.UNCONFIGURED_RELAY: The cluster has not configured its opt-in model relay.
readiness.UNCONFIGURED_MODEL: The endpoint has no model configured.
readiness.refused: Prompt access was refused. APP_UPDATE permission and the endpoint's environment policy are required.
readiness.missing: The endpoint is no longer visible or available.
readiness.unselected: Choose a visible endpoint to check prompt readiness.

errors.unavailable: The endpoint is unavailable for this prompt.
errors.timedOut: The agent did not return a reply within the bounded wait.
errors.failed: The endpoint or relay reported a failed prompt.
errors.rateLimited: The prompt rate limit was reached. Wait before submitting again.
errors.conflict: Another prompt job is already running on this cluster. Try later.
errors.invalid: The prompt is empty or exceeds its character limit.
errors.transport: Could not obtain a prompt result. The server job may still finish; it was not retried.

versionMismatch.changed: This item was modified by another session. Refresh and retry.
